findings.detail: Hamilton Thorne's EUR label qualifies par amount only; fair value 13,017 is in the schedule's separate USD fair-value column.
Sonar Acquisitionco's AUD label qualifies par amount only; fair value 3,825 is in the schedule's separate USD fair-value column.

rationale: Class 1 review of both flagged cells. In each source row, EUR or AUD appears in the Par/Shares currency position, not the Fair Value position. The table structure separately labels Cost and Fair Value, and neighboring rows display dollar signs in those columns. Footnote (4) explicitly says foreign-currency notation applies to par amount. The pipeline therefore propagated the par currency into fair_value_currency; both stored non-USD fair-value units are real extraction errors.
